help.intro:
How to play:

Press any button to control the game. After each command, the game will advance a few seconds and update the image.

You can also build a sequence of commands and send them all at once.
help.player_commands:
/resume - Resumes the game in a new message
/print - Captures the current screen and sends it to the chat
/recap - Sends the last animation clip again
/status - Shows some status information
/help - Shows this help message
help.admin_commands:
/start\_game - Starts or restarts the game
/save [slot] - Saves the game to a slot
/load [slot] - Loads the game from a slot
/m [text] - Sets custom message (no text = revert to default)
/peek\_symbol <symbol> [length=1] - Reads hex bytes from a symbol's address

help.message:
*➔ How to play*

Press the onscreen buttons to control the game. The game GIF should update and play automatically after a moment.

Button sequences are HIGHLY encouraged: tap up to {sequence_length} buttons in quick succession and they will all show up in a single update!

*➔ GIF not playing?*

Due to a bug in some Telegram clients, the game GIF may occasionally fail to load after an update. When that happens, tap '📚 HELP' to jump to this screen and then tap the button below to resume the game. Changing screens like this usually makes the GIF load properly.

Also make sure automatic media downloads are enabled in your [Telegram settings](tg://settings) under Data and Storage.

*➔ The wait between GIF updates is too long*

We comply with Telegram's API rate limits, so we cannot always rapid fire updates. However you may occasionally get shorter delays on quick actions if you tap the 👁️ button once after your input.

*➔ How do I customize my player card?*

Every button press earns you points that you can spend in the '💎 POINTS SHOP' for customizations and in-game reactions. Inputs are worth more if other players have acted recently, [invite your friends](tg://msg_url?url=https%3A%2F%2Ft.me%2F{chat_username}) to play! Daily streaks (🔥) also award an increasing amount of points the longer you keep them up.
